paper.title: Accurate neural quantum states for interacting lattice bosons

results.system_description: Bose-Hubbard model, Eq. (1), 8x8 square lattice, periodic, N = 64 bosons (unit filling), U/J = 8.5, no truncation of the occupation per site
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy E_theta/(J L^2) of the optimized neural backflow Jastrow state, estimated by Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampling of |psi|^2 (Appendix B); the GFMC and Pei-Clark rows of Table 1 are other calculations.
results.notes: Energy per site in units of J, as printed. Hamiltonian Eq. (1): -J sum over nearest-neighbour bonds (a_i^dag a_j + a_j^dag a_i) + (U/2) sum_i a_i^dag a_i^dag a_i a_i. Periodic boundaries and unit filling are stated for the 16x16 and 20x20 calculations (Sec. on the V-score) and inferred here from the comparison with Pei and Clark (10x10, periodic, unit filling) and from the authors' code (NetKet Fock space with N = L^2, periodic hypercube). No local Hilbert-space truncation (Conclusion). Table 1 runs used 32768 samples (Appendix C).

results.system_description: Bose-Hubbard model, Eq. (1), 8x8 square lattice, periodic, N = 64 bosons (unit filling), U/J = 16.8, no truncation of the occupation per site
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy E_theta/(J L^2) of the optimized neural backflow Jastrow state, estimated by Markov-chain Monte Carlo sampling of |psi|^2 (Appendix B); the GFMC and Pei-Clark rows of Table 1 are other calculations.
results.notes: Energy per site in units of J, as printed. Periodic lattice at unit filling (Sec. on the V-score and Fig. 2). No local Hilbert-space truncation. 8192 samples in the optimization (Table 2 caption). Depth D of the residual backflow network, 3x3 filters, 12 channels. The D = 0 row of Table 2 is a two-body Jastrow without a neural network and is not an entry. V-score 5.6e-5 (Table 2).
